description: This Java class 'OpenAPISerialiser' handles serialization of OpenAPI definitions, including converting OpenAPIDefinition objects to JSON strings, retrieving specific operations from OpenAPI specs, and managing server URL expansions.

classes.name: OpenAPISerialiser
classes.description: A utility class for serializing OpenAPI definitions, retrieving operations, and handling server URL expansions.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Converts an OpenAPIDefinition to its JSON string representation, either the full spec or a specific operation.

methods.name: serverUrlWithVariablesExpanded
methods.description: Expands server URL variables into their default values.

methods.name: firstValidServerPath
methods.description: Returns the first valid server path from provided server lists.

methods.name: retrieveOperation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific operation from an OpenAPI spec by operationId.

methods.name: retrieveOperations
methods.description: Retrieves all operations matching a given operationId from an OpenAPI object.
